items.title: RESTRAINT
items.quote: I resolved to watch my attitude and avoid sinning with my tongue. I would keep my mouth muzzled.
items.text: Follow David’s example and restrain your natural tendency to feel resentful about the difficulties you encounter in life. Hashem has sent those difficulties to you for a purpose.

items.w: נאלמתי דומיה החשיתי מטוב וכאבי נעכר
items.quote: I became mute, totally silent. I kept quiet [even] from good though my pain was intense.

items.w: הנה טפחות נתתה ימי וחלדי כאין נגדך
items.title: PERSPECTIVE
items.quote: Behold, You have set my days in handbreadths. My life span is insignificant before You.
items.text: If your difficulties are making you feel desperate and frustrated, curb your resentment by putting your situation in perspective. Realize how insignificant you are in the vastness of Creation. Don’t feel that you have a right to a pleasant situation in life because of who you are.

items.w: יתהלך איש אך הבל יהמיון יצבר ולא ידע מי אספם
items.title: WEALTH
items.quote: [Man’s] hectic activity is but futility. He accumulates, but he does not know who will gather them in.
items.text: Don’t focus your energy and resources on gathering wealth. It won’t last and your efforts will have been wasted. Any wealth you assemble is insignificant in the overall scheme of things.

items.title: RENEWAL
items.quote: And now, for what do I hope, O Master? My yearning is to You.
items.text: Realize that expectations of gratification in this world are misplaced. The ultimate meaning of life is not physical, but spiritual, and so you should yearn for fulfillment through bonding with your Creator.

items.title: FORGIVENESS
items.quote: Rescue me from all my transgressions.
items.text: Ask Hashem to forgive your transgressions and rescue you from being caught up in their consequences.

items.w: הסר מעלי נגעך מתגרת ידך אני כליתי
items.title: HEALING
items.quote: Take Your affliction from me; I am completely devastated by the assault of Your hand.
items.text: Ask Hashem to heal your affliction for it has already accomplished its purpose.

items.w: שמעה תפלתי יהוה ושועתי האזינה אל דמעתי אל תחרש
items.title: APPEAL TO BE HEARD
items.quote: Hear my prayer, Hashem, and give ear to my outcry; don’t be silent to my tears.
items.text: Ask Hashem to listen to your tefillah respond to your heartfelt emotions.

items.w: כי גר אנכי עמך תושב ככל אבותי
items.quote: For I am a sojourner before You, a temporary resident like all my forefathers.

items.w: השע ממני ואבליגה בטרם אלך ואינני
items.quote: Release me and let me recover before I depart and I am no more.
